## Summary
- Defer saved pipeline rename input focus/selection until the rename modal is visible.
- Add Cypress coverage for selecting the existing saved pipeline name and replacing it by typing immediately.

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#186

## Reproduction
1. Open Pipeline mode with a saved pipeline.
2. Right-click the saved pipeline and choose Rename.
3. The current name should be focused and fully selected so typing immediately replaces it.

## Tests
- PASS: npm run build
- PASS: npm run typecheck
- PASS: npm test -- --runInBand
- PARTIAL: npm run test:e2e -- --spec cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js (25 passing, including the new rename regression; 3 unrelated existing failures: stage navigator active state, relative publish date expectation, full album generated timestamps)
title: Fix saved pipeline rename input focus

body:
## Summary

- **Rename input unresponsive** — Typing was often impossible after opening the rename modal. Fixed by wrapping \`focus()\`/\`select()\` in \`requestAnimationFrame()\` so the input reliably gets keyboard focus after the browser commits the \`display: flex\` layout change.
- **Sidebar closes while modal is active** — \`scheduleClosePresetSidebar()\` did not check if any preset modal was open. Fixed by adding guards for \`presetRenameModal\`, \`presetSaveModal\`, and \`presetDeleteModal\` active state.
- **Delete broken in Electron** — \`window.confirm()\` silently returns \`false\` in Electron 33 with \`contextIsolation: true\`. Replaced with a custom HTML confirmation modal (\`#presetDeleteModal\`) consistent with the rest of the UI.
- **Deleted presets reappear after restart** — When a preset folder is configured, presets exist both in localStorage and as \`.json\` files on disk. \`confirmPresetDelete\` only removed from localStorage, leaving the file on disk. On restart, \`loadPresetsFromFolder\` re-added the "deleted" preset. Fixed by deleting the \`.json\` file via a new \`preset-delete-file\` Electron IPC call.
- **Renamed presets revert after restart** — Same architectural gap: \`renamePreset\` updated localStorage but never wrote back to the \`.json\` file on disk. On restart, \`loadPresetsFromFolder\` read the old file and \`mergePresets\` overwrote the renamed entry with the old name. Fixed by writing the updated preset JSON back to disk via a new \`preset-update-file\` Electron IPC call.

## Changes

- \`examples/app-core.js\` — \`requestAnimationFrame\` for focus, modal guards in close timer, new delete dialog functions, async file deletion on confirm, async file update on rename
- \`examples/index.html\` — new \`#presetDeleteModal\` markup
- \`examples/styles.css\` — \`.modal-message\` style for delete confirmation text
- \`electron/main.js\` — new \`preset-delete-file\` and \`preset-update-file\` IPC handlers
- \`electron/preload.js\` — expose \`deletePresetFile\` and \`updatePresetFile\` on \`window.electronAPI\`
- \`cypress/e2e/preset-management.cy.js\` — updated existing test, added 3 new tests covering the specific bugs
- \`docs/case-studies/issue-159/README.md\` — updated with all 5 root causes

## Screenshots

**Rename modal (input focused, ready to type):**
![Rename modal](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-audio-recorder-with-visualization/blob/issue-159-e3c32bd2d4b0/docs/screenshots/issue-159-rename-modal-after-fix.png?raw=true)

**Delete confirmation modal (replaces window.confirm):**
![Delete modal](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-audio-recorder-with-visualization/blob/issue-159-e3c32bd2d4b0/docs/screenshots/issue-159-delete-modal-after-fix.png?raw=true)

## Test plan

- [x] All 10 Cypress tests pass (\`cypress/e2e/preset-management.cy.js\`)
- [x] New test: \`rename input receives focus and accepts typing after context menu click\`
- [x] New test: \`delete confirmation uses a custom modal instead of window.confirm\`
- [x] New test: \`persists rename to disk via updatePresetFile when sourcePath is present\`
- [x] Case study: \`docs/case-studies/issue-159/README.md\`


Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#159
title: Fix preset rename input focus and delete confirmation dialog
